'''''Narcissus calcicola''''' is a species of ''[[Narcissus (plant)|narcissus]]'' (daffodils) in the family [[Amaryllidaceae]].  It is classified in Section ''Apodanthi''. It is [[endemic]] to [[Portugal]].<ref name="iucn status 20 November 2021" />

==Description==
[[File:Narcissus.calcicola.7113.jpg|thumb|left]]
''Narcissus calcicola'' is a [[bulbous]] plant.<ref name="listavermelha" />

==Distribution and habitat==
''Narcissus calcicola'' is [[endemic]] to Portugal and is found primarily in crevices of [[limestone]] outcrops and less frequently in rocky clearings, on the edge of [[Quercus rotundifolia|holm oak]] groves or even under forest cover.<ref>{{cite web |title=Narcissus calcicola |url=https://flora-on.pt/#/1narcissus+calcicola |publisher=Flora-on |access-date=26 December 2020}}</ref> Its range includes Serra de Sicó, [[Serras de Aire e Candeeiros Natural Park|Serras de Aire e Candeeiros]], [[Serra de Montejunto Protected Landscape|Serra de Montejunto]], [[Arrábida Natural Park|Serra da Arrábida]] and the [[Algarve|Algarvian]] Barrocal.<ref name="listavermelha">{{cite web |title=Narcissus calcicola Mendonça | date=11 July 2017 |url=https://listavermelha-flora.pt/flora-single/?slug=Narcissus-calcicola |publisher=listavermelha-flora.pt |access-date=26 December 2020}}</ref>
